intro: Dana, you told us leads from your website and Google listing are going cold because nobody calls back for a day or two, and that you have no idea which jobs come from where. This scope fixes both: every inquiry gets an answer in minutes, and you see leads, estimates and revenue in one place.

items.note: Your crew is on roofs all day, so most calls go to voicemail.
Targets the two-day callback gap you described.
Breaks results out by Google, referrals and door-knocking.

assumptions: You already have a Google Business Profile and a working website.
Two team members will use the system.
